root.label: DOJ lawsuit against University of Delaware over immigrant in-state tuition

events.label: DOJ lawsuit against University of Delaware over immigrant in-state tuition

slots.name: lawsuit count
slots.sentence: Thursday's lawsuit is the 26th that The Trump administration has filed challenging in-state tuition policies for certain undocumented immigrants.

slots.name: enrollment deadline
slots.sentence: The Justice Department is asking the court to enjoin the university and its board of trustees from enforcing the policy.

slots.name: school attendance requirement
slots.sentence: attended a Delaware high school for at least three years

slots.name: enrollment window
slots.sentence: They must also provide evidence that they are seeking U.S. citizenship or permanent residency and be enrolled at the university within 18 months from graduating high school.
